车队协作实验 / Signal Convoy

指挥运输车、电台与护卫，练习资源作用域、消息和运输关系
A carrier, radio pod and escort for learning resource scopes, messages and transport relationships

使用方式 / Getting started
导入 .rwmod，启用并重新加载，在沙盒搜索 rwa07 或 rwa08
Import the .rwmod, enable it and reload, then search the sandbox for rwa07 or rwa08

1 创建两辆指挥运输车和两辆护卫，分别查看状态
  Create two carriers and two escorts, then inspect both carriers
2 用第一辆指挥车采购储备，用第二辆领取补给，对比队伍储备与车载库存
  Buy stock with the first carrier and load supplies with the second, compare team stock with onboard inventory
3 用联络信号按钮给一辆指挥车发送三次消息，另一辆信号计数应保持原值
  Send three signals to one carrier, the other carrier should keep its original signal count
4 让两辆护卫装入一辆指挥车，再卸载，观察乘员数与电台的位置
  Load both escorts into one carrier and unload them, observe passenger count and radio position

代码学习提示 / Code notes
先在副本中修改一个数值，重新加载后再观察其他组合
Change one value in a working copy and reload before trying combinations

素材许可 / Asset credits
代码与说明为本课程原创，24×24 PNG 复用 Rusted Warfare Mod Academy 的 CC0 教学像素图片
Original lesson code and prose, 24x24 PNG assets reuse the Academy CC0 tutorial pixel sprites
CC0-1.0 https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

游戏表现仍需在 Rusted Warfare 1.15 中核实
In-game behavior still requires verification in Rusted Warfare 1.15
